title: Publish the first GitHub Release
description: After direct-download and in-place update validation passes, finalize release notes, tag the first semantic version, run the release workflow, confirm every executable and checksum is attached, and verify that the published binary reports the tag through wtp version and can discover future releases through wtp update.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Published public v0.1.0; verified all six assets/checksums, host metadata, unauthenticated release discovery, safe update, CI, and release workflow.
